word-steering-wheel.def: the round part in front of the driver that is turned to change direction

word-brake.def: the pedal you press with your foot to make a vehicle go slower or halt

word-accelerator.def: the pedal you press with your foot to make a vehicle go faster

word-clutch.def: the pedal that lets the driver change gears in a manual car

word-gear.def: one of the settings of a car that controls its power and speed

word-gearbox.def: the part of a car that sends power from the engine to the wheels

word-tire.def: a thick rubber ring around a wheel that touches the road

word-spare-tire.def: an extra wheel kept in the car for emergencies

word-seat-belt.def: a strap that holds you in place in a car to keep you safe in a crash

word-rear-view-mirror.def: the small glass inside a car, above the windshield, that shows the road behind

word-side-mirror.def: one of the two glasses on the outside of a car that show the sides and back

word-windshield.def: the large glass at the front of a car that the driver looks through

word-wiper.def: a moving arm that cleans rain from the front glass of a car

word-headlights.def: the bright lights at the front of a car that light the road at night

word-turn-signal.def: a light that flashes to show other drivers which way you will turn

word-car-horn.def: a device that makes a loud sound to warn other drivers

word-hood.def: the metal cover over the front of a car where the engine is

word-trunk-car.def: the space at the back of a car where you put bags and other things

word-bumper.def: a bar at the front or back of a car that protects it in a small crash

word-license-plate.def: a metal sign with letters and numbers on the front or back of a vehicle

word-dashboard.def: the panel in front of the driver with the speedometer and other controls

word-speedometer.def: the instrument that shows how fast a vehicle is going

word-airbag.def: a cushion in a car that fills with air in a crash to protect people

word-handbrake.def: the lever or pedal that keeps a parked car from rolling

word-motor-oil.def: a slippery liquid that keeps the parts of an engine moving smoothly

word-overtake.def: to go by another vehicle that is moving more slowly

word-brake-v.def: to make a vehicle go slower or halt by using the pedal

word-change-lanes.def: to move from one strip of the road to the one beside it

word-give-way.def: to let other vehicles go first at a junction or crossing

word-honk.def: to make a loud sound with a car's warning device

word-indicate.def: to show with a flashing light which way you will turn

word-start-engine.def: to make a car's motor begin to run

word-refuel.def: to put more gas into a vehicle's tank

word-tow.def: to pull a broken vehicle behind another one

word-skid.def: to slide on the road without control

word-lane.def: one of the strips of a road for a single line of cars

word-roundabout.def: a circular intersection where cars go around in one direction

word-crosswalk.def: a marked place where people on foot can go across the street

word-pedestrian.def: a person who is walking, not riding or driving

word-cyclist.def: a person who rides a bike

word-traffic-jam.def: a long line of cars that are barely moving

word-toll.def: money you pay to use a certain road or bridge

word-speed-limit.def: the fastest speed that drivers are allowed to go on a road

word-speed-camera.def: a camera by the road that takes photos of cars going too fast

word-stop-sign.def: a red eight-sided sign that tells drivers they must halt

word-one-way-street.def: a road where cars may go in only one direction

word-dead-end.def: a road that is closed at one end so you cannot go through

word-detour.def: a longer way you take because the usual road is closed

word-roadworks.def: repair or building work being done on a street or highway

word-parking-meter.def: a machine on the street where you pay to leave your car for a while

word-right-of-way.def: the legal permission to go first at a junction

word-priority-road.def: a main street whose drivers go first at the side streets that join it

word-traffic-police.def: officers who control cars on the street and fine drivers who break the law

word-breathalyzer.def: a device that measures how much alcohol is in a person's breath

word-drunk-driving.def: the crime of operating a vehicle after having too much alcohol

word-speeding.def: going faster than the law allows on the road

word-penalty-points.def: marks added to a driver's record when they break traffic laws

word-drivers-license.def: an official card that gives you permission to operate a car

word-driving-school.def: a place where people learn to operate a car with a teacher

word-driving-instructor.def: a person whose job is to teach others to operate a car

word-driving-test.def: the exam you must pass to get a license

word-theory-test.def: the exam with questions about traffic signs and rules, taken on paper or a screen

word-practical-test.def: the exam in which an examiner watches you operate a car

word-learner-driver.def: a person who is still learning to operate a car

word-international-driving-permit.def: a document that lets you operate a car in other countries along with your own license

word-vehicle-registration.def: the official record that shows who owns a car

word-vehicle-inspection.def: a check by an official to see if a car is safe to use

word-tow-truck.def: a strong vehicle that carries or pulls broken cars away

word-car-rental.def: a business or service that lets you pay to use a vehicle for a short time

word-gasoline.def: the liquid fuel that most cars burn to run

word-diesel.def: a type of fuel used in trucks and some cars

word-electric-car.def: a vehicle that runs on a battery instead of gasoline

word-charging-station.def: a place where you can put power into an electric vehicle's battery

word-car-wash.def: a place where vehicles are cleaned by machines or workers

word-flat-tire.def: a wheel that has lost its air, so the vehicle can't go

word-breakdown.def: a time when a vehicle stops working on the road

word-warning-triangle.def: a red three-sided sign placed on the road to warn others of a stopped car

word-reflective-vest.def: a bright jacket without sleeves that makes you easy to see in the dark

word-van.def: a covered vehicle, bigger than a car, used to carry people or goods

word-trailer.def: a vehicle without an engine that is pulled behind another vehicle

word-traffic-rules.def: the laws that tell drivers how to behave on the street

word-dmv-us.def: the state office where people get licenses and register vehicles

word-shaken-jp.gl: shaken: Japan's mandatory periodic vehicle inspection

word-wakaba-mark-jp.gl: wakaba mark: green-and-yellow sticker for new drivers in Japan

word-tuv-de.gl: TÜV: German vehicle safety inspection, required regularly

word-itv-es.gl: ITV: Spain's mandatory technical inspection of vehicles

word-apk-nl.gl: APK: Dutch periodic roadworthiness inspection for vehicles

word-kteo-gr.gl: KTEO: Greek vehicle technical inspection center

word-muayene-tr.gl: araç muayenesi: Turkey's periodic vehicle inspection

word-revisione-it.gl: revisione: Italy's mandatory periodic vehicle inspection

word-besiktning-se.gl: besiktning: Swedish mandatory vehicle inspection at an approved station

word-tsc-mvs-ua.gl: TSC MVS: Ukrainian office for driving licenses, vehicle registration and exams

word-nct-ie.gl: NCT: Ireland's National Car Test, the mandatory roadworthiness inspection

word-mot-uk.gl: MOT: British annual roadworthiness test for vehicles over three years old

word-muszaki-vizsga-hu.gl: műszaki vizsga: Hungarian periodic vehicle inspection, shown by a plate sticker

word-dang-kiem-vn.gl: đăng kiểm: Vietnamese mandatory technical and emissions inspection of vehicles
